Welcome to LingXi Mobile

LingXi is a remote control: all compute runs on your own computer/server, the phone only controls it.

Auto-scanning for LingXi engines on the same Wi-Fi…
Tap a result to connect.

Or tap "Change engine address" below:
· Choose "My Cloud", enter your own cloud address and sign in for remote control
· Or enter an engine address manually

Pick a device to connect:

· 💻 LAN engine: direct connection, fastest
· 🌐 My Cloud: your own self-hosted cloud LingXi; sign in with the same account as your PC, all your online engines are listed automatically and can be taken over from anywhere

No LingXi engine was found on this Wi-Fi.

· Make sure the engine is running on your computer
· Or choose "My Cloud": enter your own cloud address, sign in and control it remotely, no shared Wi-Fi needed
· You can also enter an address manually (public / Tailscale, etc.)
🌐 My Cloud · remote control (your own server)

Enter the address of your own self-hosted cloud LingXi. After signing in with the same account as your PC, your phone can take over your home computer from anywhere.\n\nNo cloud server yet? The download page on the official site has a one-click deployment guide (Docker / install script). Deploy it on your own server — your data stays yours.
